spans.s: जिवाजिव m. The chakora bird.
जीवजीव m. the chakora bird.

जीव् vi. 1P (pp. जीवित; pres. जीवति; caus. जीवयति, जीवापयति) 1. To live, to be alive, यावत् त्रयस्ते जीवेयुः M.ii.235, संशयं पुनारारुह्य यदि जीवति पश्यति Hit.i.; 2. to revive, to come to life; 3. to make a livelihood, to live by, (with an inst.), विपणेन च जीवंतः M.iii.152, iv.6 (in this sense, the root is sometimes used with a cognate acc., e.g. जीवेद्वैश्यस्य जीविकाम् M.x.82); 4. to live upon, to prey upon, (with a loc.), e.g. चौराः प्रमत्ते जीवंति व्याधितेषु चिकित्सकाः । प्रमदाः कामयानेषु यजमानेषु याजकाः । राजा विवदमानेषु नित्यं मूर्खेषु पंडिताः.With अति-, to surpass in living, to live more splendidly or happily, अत्यजीवदमरालकेश्वरौ R.xix.15.With अनु-, 1. to imitate the life of अन्वजीवत् (v.l. for अत्यजीवत्) अमरालकेश्वरौ R.xix.15; 2. to live for, to serve, to live by or by means of, (with an acc.), e.g. यां तां श्रियमसूयामः पुरा दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरे । अद्य तामनुजीवामः; 3. to survive, to outlive.With आ-, to get a living from, (with an acc.), e.g. यमाजीवंति पुरुषं सर्वभूतानि … … तस्य जीवितमर्थवत्.With उद्-, to return to life, to revive, उदजीवत् सुमित्राभूः Bt.xvii.95.With उप-, to maintain oneself by, (with an acc. of the person or profession), शेषास्तमुपजीवेयुर्यथैव पितरं तथा M.ix.105, संवाहकस्य वृत्तिमुपजीवामि Mrich.ii., Sis.ix.32.
जीव (I) a. (f. वा) Living, existing.
जीव (II) m. 1. The principle of life, the vital breath, श्वासोत्कंपकुचं निरीक्ष्य सुचिरं जीवाशया वारितः Am.

; 2. the personal soul cased in the body (as distinguished from the supreme soul or परमात्मन्), M.xii.22; 3. life, existence; 4. a creature, a living being; 5. livelihood, profession; 6. an epithet of Bṛhaspati; 7. an epithet of Karṇa; 8. the constellation called पुष्य.
जीव (I) a. (f. वा) Living, existing.
जीवा f. 1. Water; 2. the earth; 3. a bowstring, चापस्य जीवा चकृषे जवेन R.G.; 4. the chord of an arc; 5. means of living; 6. the tinkling of metallic ornaments.
जीव-अंतक m. 1. a bird-catcher, a fowler; 2. a murderer.
जीव-आत्मन् m. the individual soul enshrined in the human body (as distinguished from परमात्मन् ‘the supreme soul’).
जीव-आदान n. abstracting blood, bleeding (in medicine).
जीव-आधान n. preservation of life.
जीव-धन n. property consisting of living creatures, live stock.
जीव-आधार m. the heart.
जीव-इंधन n. glowing firewood, burning wood.
जीव-उत्सर्ग m. voluntary death, suicide.
जीव-ऊर्णा f. the wool of a living animal.
जीव-गृह, -मंदिर n. the body, as being the abode of the soul.
जीव-गृह, -मंदिर n. the body, as being the abode of the soul.
जीव-ग्राह m. a prisoner taken alive.
जीवजीव m. the chakora bird.
जीव-द m. 1. a physician; 2. an enemy.
जीव-दशा f. mortal existence.
जीव-धानी f. the earth.
जीव-पति, -पत्नी f. a woman whose husband is alive.
जीव-पति, -पत्नी f. a woman whose husband is alive.
जीव-पुत्र, -वत्सा f. a woman whose son is living.
जीव-पुत्र, -वत्सा f. a woman whose son is living.
जीव-मातृका f. the seven mothers (i.e. female deities, viz., कुमारी धनदा नंदा विमला मंगला बला । पद्मा चेति च विख्याताः सप्तैता जीवमातृकाः).
जीव-रक्त n. menstrual blood.
जीव-लोक m. 1. the world of living beings, the world of mortals, स्वप्नेंद्रजालसदृशाः खलु जीवलोकः Sant.S.ii.2, Bg.xv.7; 2. mankind, आलोकमर्कादिव जीवलोकः R.v.35.
जीव-वृत्ति f. breeding or keeping cattle.
जीव-शेष a. one whose life only remains and nothing more.
जीव-संक्रमण n. transmigration of the soul.
जीव-साधन n. grain, corn.
जीव-साफल्य n. in realization of the principal wishes of human existence.
जीव-सू f. a woman whose son is living.
जीव-स्थान n. a joint, an articulation.
जीवक m. 1. A living being; 2. a servant; 3. a Buddhist mendicant; 4. an usurer; 5. a snake-catcher.
जीवत् a. (f. न्ती) Living, alive.
जीवत् a. (f. न्ती) Living, alive.
जीवत्-तोका f. a woman who has living children.
जीवत्-पति, -पत्नी f. a woman whose husband is living.
जीवत्-पति, -पत्नी f. a woman whose husband is living.
जीवन्मुक्त m. a man purified by knowledge of Brahman (n.) and exonerated from future birth and all ritual rites while yet living.
जीवन्मुक्ति f. final liberation in the present state of life.
जीवन्मृत a. dead while alive, i.e. useless to others, lost to all sense of virtue &c.
जीवथ m. 1. Life, existence; 2. a tortoise; 3. a peacock; 4. a cloud.
जीवन (I) a. (f. नी) Enlivening, giving life.
जीवन (II) m. 1. A living being; 2. wind; 3. a son.

जीवन (III) n. 1. Principle of life, vitality, Bg.vii.9; 2. life, existence; 3. water, जीवनं (3) जीवनं (1) हंति प्राणान् हंति समीरणः Ud.; 4. livelihood, profession, M.xi.76; 5. butter made from milk one day old; 6. marrow.
जीवन (I) a. (f. नी) Enlivening, giving life.
जीवन-अंत m. death.
जीवन-आघात n. poison.
जीवन-आवास m. 1. the body; 2. an epithet of Varuṇa, the regent of water.
जीवन-उपाय m. livelihood.
जीवन-औषध n. elixir vitæ.
जीवनक n. Food.
जीवनीय n. Water.
जीवंत m. 1. Life, existence; 2. a drug, a medicament.
जीवंतिक m. A fowler.
जीवातु m.n. 1. Victuals, food; 2. life, existence; 3. restoration to life, रे हस्त दक्षिण मृतस्य शिशोर्द्विजस्य जीवितवे विसृज शूद्रमुनौ कृपाणम् Ut.ii.; 4. a medicine for restoring life.
जीविका f. Means of living, livelihood.
जीवित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Living, alive, R.xii.75; 2. returned to life; 3. animated, (pp. of जीव् q.v.).
जीवित (II) n. 1. Life, existence, कन्येयं कुलजीवितम् K.S.vi.63, नाभिनंदेत मरणं नाभिनंदेत जीवितम् M.vi.45; 2. duration of life; 3. livelihood.
जीवित (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Living, alive, R.xii.75; 2. returned to life; 3. animated, (pp. of जीव् q.v.).
जीवित-अंतक m. an epithet of Śiva.
जीवित-आशा f. hope of life, love of life.
जीवित-ईश m. 1. a lover, a husband; 2. an epithet of Yama, जीवितेशवसतिं जगाम सा R.xi.20 (where the word is used in senses 1 and 2); 3. the sun; 4. the moon.
जीवित-काल m. duration of life.
जीवित-ज्ञा f. an artery.
जीवित-व्यय m. sacrifice of life.
जीवित-संशय m. risk of life, fear of death, अयि जीवितसंशयः प्रयाणे Bh.V.ii.20.
जीविन् (I) a. (f. नी) (generally at the end of compounds) 1. Living, existing, R.i.63; 2. living upon or by, e.g. आयुधजीविन्.
जीविन् (II) m. A living being.
जीविन् (I) a. (f. नी) (generally at the end of compounds) 1. Living, existing, R.i.63; 2. living upon or by, e.g. आयुधजीविन्.
जीव्या f. Means of livelihood.
